metas.name: 365 dni
metas.description: Massimo is a member of the Sicilian Mafia family and Laura is a sales director. She does not expect that on a trip to Sicily trying to save her relationship, Massimo will kidnap her and give her 365 days to fall in love with him.

metas.name: Heart of the Beast
metas.description: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

metas.name: Son of Sardaar
metas.description: Realizing he is the target of a vengeful family that welcomed him without knowing his identity, a young man must avoid exiting their house since they won't kill a guest unless he's outside.

metas.name: Mirzapur: The Movie
metas.description: Akhandanand Tripathi sits on the throne of Mirzapur. Munna Tripathi is heir apparent. Rati Shankar Shukla is the rival from Jaunpur. And, Guddu and Bablu are the two brothers who came like a tornado and changed things irreversibly. And now comes a new claimant in town. Babban Babua, from the desert of Jaisalmer. A ruthless man who is power hungry.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.
Ram and Janani are high school sweethearts who eventually get married. However, Janani is mystified when Ram commits suicide all of a sudden and she tries to find out the truth behind his death.

metas.name: The Mongoose
metas.description: A highly decorated combat vet, Ryan ''Fang'' Flanagan, is fleeing a murder scene at 130 miles an hour in a Mustang Shelby Super Snake GT350.

metas.name: I'm Game
metas.description: A fearless gambler who trusts luck more than life gets caught in a series of crazy and unexpected events that turn his world upside down.

metas.name: Adipurush
metas.description: A modern adaptation of the Indian epic Ramayana which follows the exiled prince Raghav's journey to rescue his wife Janaki from the demon king Lankesh.

metas.name: Jurassic World: Rebirth
metas.description: Five years post-Jurassic World: Dominion (2022), an expedition braves isolated equatorial regions to extract DNA from three massive prehistoric creatures for a groundbreaking medical breakthrough.

metas.name: Resident Evil
metas.description: Described as a revamp that will return to the franchise's horror roots and be more faithful to the initial games.

metas.name: Bairavaa
metas.description: Bairavaa, a gallant debt collector, takes on a violent criminal masquerading as a philanthropist in the education field.

metas.name: Pradhama Drishtiya Kuttakkar
metas.description: After her husband's tragic death, Aleena joins the police force through a compassionate appointment. What begins as a quiet new chapter soon turns into a high-stakes battle of wits and courage, testing everything she believes about justice, loyalty, and herself.

metas.name: Immortal
metas.description: An unsuspecting man finds himself at the center of a series of mysterious deaths, forcing him to confront a truth that could cost him everything.

metas.name: Race
metas.description: Destiny makes two brothers- Ranvir and Rajiv - enemies of each other. Everything is fair in love and war.

metas.name: Baa Baa Black Sheep
metas.description: A single misplaced object sets off a wild 24-hour chain reaction, sweeping six strangers into chaotic fun. As it changes hands, petty blunders and comic mix-ups collide, forging unexpected connections that upend all their lives forever.

metas.name: Abrahaminte Santhathikal
metas.description: Derick Abraham, a fiery and dutiful police officer, continues to be the best officer until his brother Philip Abraham gets arrested for false murder charges. Will he be able to investigate the case and serve justice to his brother?

metas.name: Possible Love
metas.description: Four strangers' paths cross by chance, leading to complex emotional entanglements that challenge their existing relationships and force them to confront uncomfortable truths about love and commitment.

metas.name: How to Have Sex
metas.description: Three British teenage girls go on a rites-of-passage holiday - drinking, clubbing and hooking up, in what should be the best summer of their lives.

metas.name: Soorma
metas.description: Soorma is the story of the triumph of the human spirit, about a player, who made headlines for his miraculous comeback after facing a near death experience through sheer determination, hard work and unrelenting passion for the sport.

metas.name: The Invite
metas.description: Joe and Angela's marriage is on the rocks. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors over for dinner, the evening takes an unexpected turn.

metas.name: I Love You
metas.description: Sathya is a highly successful corporate executive who look forward to a bright future with her fiance,Vishal.One night ,when she is about to board a fight to Delhi, Satya finds herself trapped within the office .What danger awaits her?

metas.name: Meesaya Murukku 2
metas.description: The continuation of Hiphop Tamizha Adhi's semi-biopic Meesaya Murukku (2017), which consists of the journey of starting his own band called "Hip-Hop Tamizha."

metas.name: Akhanda
metas.description: When the nefarious Varadarajulu plans to attack Murali Krishna, an ardent devotee of Lord Shiva, Akhanda leaves no stone unturned to defeat the evil.

metas.name: Godzilla Minus One
metas.description: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

metas.name: Obsession
metas.description: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

metas.name: Eleven
metas.description: A brave and skilled officer with a strong record of solving tough cases is assigned to a new, more challenging serial killing investigation.

metas.name: Cerita Lila
metas.description: Following a fatal history of severe maternal domestic abuse, the discarnate spirit of a young twin navigates the afterlife in a desperate search for her separated sister, uncovering a clandestine metaphysical conspiracy designed to obscure the truth of their deaths.

metas.name: Maamannan
metas.description: The community that was exploited by the town's influential man, who completely rules due to the powerful backing of the authorities. A man collects evidence to flip him upside down when he was helpless to stop his endless torture.

metas.name: Jailer
metas.description: Muthuvel Pandian, a retired, stern yet compassionate jailer lives a peaceful life with his family, but trouble knocks his door when his cop son’s tryst with an antique mafia gang goes awry and forces Muthu to step back into a dark world he had voluntarily took a break from.

metas.name: Batman: Knightfall - Part 1: Knightfall
metas.description: When the mysterious behemoth known only as Bane frees Batman's entire rogue's gallery from Arkham Asylum, the Caped Crusader is pushed to his mental and physical breaking point.

metas.name: Drishyam
metas.description: A man goes to extreme lengths to save his family from punishment after the family commits an accidental crime.

metas.name: Anakapalli
metas.description: In rural Anakapalli, a young man enters the criminal underworld under a feared gangster. When love arrives, he faces a choice between power, loyalty, and his former dreams in this tale of action and destiny.

metas.name: DC
metas.description: From avenging his mother’s murder to battling police corruption, Das becomes a fugitive after a deadly heist. Amid a trail of bloodshed and loss, he frees Chandra from a life of exploitation, and she gives him a reason to seek a life beyond violence.

metas.name: Kuttey
metas.description: A van carrying cash on a rainy night in the outskirts of Mumbai is the crosshairs of three separate gangs all with the same plan. Now that they've crossed paths who will survive?

metas.name: In the Heart of the Sea
metas.description: In the winter of 1820, the New England whaling ship Essex is assaulted by something no one could believe—a whale of mammoth size and will, and an almost human sense of vengeance.

metas.name: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
metas.description: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

metas.name: Article 370
metas.description: Ahead of a major constitutional decision, special agent Zooni Haksar is tasked with a secret mission to quell violence in a conflict-ridden region.

metas.name: The Housemaid
metas.description: Millie, a struggling young woman, becomes a live-in maid for a wealthy couple, Nina and Andrew. She enters a mansion of secrets, manipulation, and escalating psychological games that pull her into a dangerous relationship dynamic.

metas.name: Air Force One
metas.description: When Russian neo-nationalists hijack Air Force One, the world's most secure and extraordinary aircraft, the President is faced with a nearly impossible decision to give in to terrorist demands or sacrifice not only the country's dignity, but the lives of his wife and daughter.

metas.name: Puli
metas.description: A virtuous soldier tries to save people from an evil queen and a throne-seeking commander.

metas.name: Dune
metas.description: Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man born into a great destiny beyond his understanding, must travel to the most dangerous planet in the universe to ensure the future of his family and his people. As malevolent forces explode into conflict over the planet's exclusive supply of the most precious resource in existence - a commodity capable of unlocking humanity's greatest potential - only those who can conquer their fear will survive.

metas.name: The Swan: Behind the Mirror
metas.description: A look at the controversial 2004 reality series The Swan, which took self-proclaimed 'ugly ducklings' and set out to make them... not that.

metas.name: Serious Men
metas.description: Tormented with his 'under-privileged' societal status, a father capitalizes on his son's newfound fame as a boy-genius. Little does he realize that the secret he harbors will destroy the very thing he loves the most.

metas.name: Noise
metas.description: A young woman with a hearing impairment investigates her sister’s mysterious disappearance from her apartment, but as she searches for answers, strange sounds and an ominous presence begin to haunt her.

metas.name: Mookuthi Amman
metas.description: Goddess Mookuthi Amman descends on Earth and uses a television reporter to expose fake godmen.

metas.name: Chamatkar
metas.description: When Sunder loses everything, he seeks refuge in a graveyard, where he befriends a ghost.

metas.name: All Pass
metas.description: Three families from different parts of North Chennai come together through circumstances and, despite financial struggles, decide to live under one roof in Sathya Nagar. Their friendship grows into a close-knit bond, with the three families living like one. But when a conflict threatens this unity and puts their relationships at risk, they must face its consequences and decide whether their bond can survive.

metas.name: Jana Nayagan
metas.description: A clash of ideologies. One stands for the people, the other feeds on control. Their paths collided once before. Years later, a child’s silent fear ignites the past, drawing a former police officer into a battle far bigger than personal revenge.

metas.name: Doctor G
metas.description: Uday Gupta finds himself as the lone male resident in the Gynaecology department. His reluctance leads to chaos, confusion, comedy and eventually, great camaraderie with his fellow classmates.
